title: Installer: add break-glass override flag w/ explicit acknowledgement + audit log entry
author: Benji Okafor
description: Context: Offline bundle verification is fail-closed by default (see ENG-3914). For regulated/on-prem environments we need a narrow, explicit break-glass path to proceed in emergencies (e.g., urgent restore where signature material is temporarily unavailable), while ensuring (a) the user can’t do it accidentally, and (b) we have an auditable record that it happened. This PR introduces a break-glass override flag gated behind an explicit acknowledgement prompt, and emits a structured audit log entry whenever override is used. Summary of changes: 1) New CLI flag: `--break-glass-allow-unverified` (name bikeshedded during review; see comments). When provided, verification failures become non-fatal, but we still run verification and surface failures prominently. 2) Interactive acknowledgement: when the flag is provided and the CLI is attached to a TTY, the installer prompts the operator to type an exact acknowledgement string: `I UNDERSTAND THIS DISABLES OFFLINE BUNDLE INTEGRITY VERIFICATION`. Non-matching input aborts. 3) Non-interactive mode: when `--non-interactive` (or stdin is not a TTY), the operator must also pass `--break-glass-ack "I UNDERSTAND THIS DISABLES OFFLINE BUNDLE INTEGRITY VERIFICATION"` (exact match). Without the ack, we abort. 4) Audit trail: always emit a structured security event when break-glass is requested and when it is actually applied. Event includes: timestamp, installer version, bundle id (if available), verification status, failure reasons (sanitized), and operator-provided `--reason` string (required when using break-glass). 5) UX: improved error messaging to (a) steer users to fix verification, and (b) make break-glass consequences unambiguous. This does not change the default behavior: without the break-glass flag, any verification failure remains fatal. Notes/constraints: - No outbound calls; all logging remains local (stdout/stderr + local install log). - Failure reasons are sanitized (no raw signature bytes, no full paths outside bundle root). - The override is scoped to offline bundle verification only; it does not bypass other safety checks (disk space, kubectl connectivity, etc.). Testing: - Added unit tests for interactive vs non-interactive flows, exact-string match, and event emission. - Manual: validated prompts behave correctly with/without TTY and with `--non-interactive`. Follow-ups: - Docs/runbook updates in ENG-3918 (separate PR). - Potential enhancement: require a second factor (e.g., `--break-glass-ticket-id`) once we align with support/SE workflow.
commits: cli: add break-glass flags and ack plumbing
verify: downgrade verification failure to warning when break-glass is active (still run verification)
audit: emit security event for break-glass requested/applied
tests: add coverage for prompt/ack flows + logging
conversation: Marcus Lin (Security Engineering) review: "We need to make the acknowledgement unambiguous and hard to automate accidentally. Exact-string match is good; please also require a human-readable `--reason` that goes into the audit event. Also, the flag name should explicitly mention unverified/integrity. Finally: ensure logs do not include raw signature material or full host paths."

Benji Okafor (author): "Added required `--reason` when `--break-glass-allow-unverified` is set. Renamed flag from `--allow-unsafe-install` to `--break-glass-allow-unverified` and updated help text. Sanitized verification errors: now only include failure codes + bundle-relative paths."

Kevin Osei (Auditability) review: "Please emit two events: one when operator requests break-glass and one when it actually takes effect (i.e., when verification fails and we continue). Include installer version, bundle id, and a stable `event_type`. Also: add a field indicating interactive vs non-interactive path for evidence."

Benji Okafor (author): "Done. Added `security.break_glass.requested` and `security.break_glass.applied` events. Included `installer_version`, `bundle_id`, `interactive`, `reason`, and `verification_result` fields. Added tests asserting both events when appropriate."

Ethan Park (Control plane / installer verification lead) review: "Behavior question: if break-glass is set and verification PASSES, do we still prompt? I'd prefer yes (so operator doesn't accidentally leave the flag on in scripts). Also, for non-interactive mode require `--break-glass-ack` or fail."
Benji Okafor (author): "Prompt/ack is required whenever the flag is present, regardless of verification outcome. Non-interactive mode now requires `--break-glass-ack` exact match, otherwise abort."
Priya Natarajan (Platform) comment: "Make sure the override is scoped: don’t let it skip bundle unpack checksum verification if we add that later."
Benji Okafor (author): "Scoped to verification failure handling only. The verifier still runs and produces a `verification_result`; we only change whether it returns fatal error."
CI note: initial run failed on lint due to unused import in `acknowledgement.go`; fixed in follow-up commit and re-ran.
Marcus Lin final: "Ack string + reason requirement looks good. Please keep the wording consistent across docs/runbooks and ensure help text calls out this is for emergency use only." Approved.
Merged by Ethan Park via squash after approvals (Security + Platform + Audit).
release_notes: Private installer: added explicit break-glass override for offline bundle verification failures (emergency use), gated by acknowledgement prompt and recorded via structured audit events.
